subject.title: fix(google-meet): force English UI when reusing existing Chrome tabs

question: May Google Meet automation reload an existing reused tab that could already contain an active user meeting?
rationale: The current patch makes tab ownership destructive; choosing between preserving the user tab, accepting replacement, or building locale-independent inspection requires explicit product ownership rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Preserve and open separately
options.body: Leave localized existing tabs untouched and open a new English plugin-owned tab for automation.

options.title: Accept in-place replacement
options.body: Keep navigation of the reused tab only with explicit acceptance of meeting-state replacement and live reconnection proof.

options.title: Make inspection locale-independent
options.body: Preserve the existing tab and replace English-only join, status, caption, and recovery matching with stable locale-independent hooks.

recommendation.title: Preserve and open separately
recommendation.body: Leave localized existing tabs untouched and open a new English plugin-owned tab for automation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main tab reuse and recovery surface is attributed to this owner in source history, making them the best available routing candidate for the ownership contract.
